headline: Is this the hardest performance in hip hop history? Minutes after Atlanta elected official
body: Is this the hardest performance in hip hop history? Minutes after Atlanta elected officials came on stage and awarded YB an award for being the goat.. they walked off stage and he performed “I Hate Youngboy” for the first time ever.
